objective: Frozen computation: for every bracketing of 5 to 8 distinctions and the one-step move of its ends' side, the knot-by-knot image of every KF3 option at every reached state is an option of the moved presentation, and the joint law of states and pairs is carried, to n0 + 3 (five and six to n0 + 4).

title: Check of the knot-by-knot correspondence
